L-3331 / C-12891 Lydia Griffiths: KYC VERIFIED, no PEP. Everyday Current Account NOT opened, and M$25,000 cash deposit NOT taken. Reason: customer wants M$25k cash with minimal paperwork; I asked for (1) beneficial-ownership confirmation that funds are hers and not for a third party, and (2) source-of-cash documents for declared business income. Customer refused to provide the paperwork and threatened to go elsewhere. Documents formally requested; customer says ~1 business day. Application on hold until received and reviewed. Note: if the deposit is taken, a LARGE_CASH report is required same day (§5). Do not split the deposit (structuring). If the customer keeps refusing or the cash source stays unclear, consider escalating to Compliance. I did not open the account or book the deposit on pressure, and did not use any exception.

Quarter: this leaves us at 47 of 48 if Lydia's account is completed in time. Branch Manager should be aware that the 48th account depends on documents, not on speed.
